title: Ship does not run a Proof command that names a placeholder
body:
Why: lane t-dz2axwx was refused its ship (exit 81) because its task Proof named `krn adopt <clone of perfect-memory>`; proofCommands (src/cli/pr-body.ts) treated a backtick span with a <placeholder> as a runnable command and sh failed with a syntax error; the lane could not edit the tracker record.
Outcome: a Proof backtick span containing a <placeholder> is not run by ship (it stays prose in the PR body).
Proof: `node --test test/cli/pr-body.test.ts`
